description:
Shiny, narrow leaves with bristle-teeth and hairy undersides.

Micrographs of the undersurfaces, included here, confirm the presence of  simple and stellate hairs as well as large multicellular trichomes. 

The trichomes are more than twice the diameter of the trichomes of C. dentata measured in a separate observation.

Pix of the staminate and pistillate flowers are included.
